content.thinking:
I need to work out the notice timeline under the RRA — since only one month's notice was given but two months is required, the earliest valid end date would be 10 Dec 2026. I'm considering ways to shorten this, like landlord agreement to a shorter notice, a surrender agreement, or finding a replacement tenant, plus how the deposit gets returned through mydeposits once deductions are agreed.

I won't release keys or an address yet, just confirm handover arrangements closer to the end date. My plan is to reply to the tenant, email the landlord to request approval for an earlier end date, and schedule a follow-up — this is routine notice handling, not a maintenance issue, so no ticket needed.

arguments.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for letting us know, and congratulations on the new job.

Since 1 May 2026 the notice a tenant needs to give is two months in writing, not one. Your email of 10 October therefore ends the tenancy on 10 December 2026 at the earliest, not 10 November. Rent stays due until the tenancy ends.

A earlier date is only possible if your landlord agrees in writing. We are asking him now whether he will accept 10 November, and we can't promise the answer. Please don't treat 10 November as agreed until we confirm it in writing. We'll update you by Wednesday 14 October.

Deposit: it is held in the mydeposits scheme. It is dealt with after the tenancy ends and the property has been checked, and any deductions would be shown to you first. We can't give a return date yet.

Keys: please keep them until we confirm the handover arrangements nearer your move-out date. We'll send those details then.

Kind regards
Mare & Co Lettings

Under the Renters' Rights Act, tenants must give two months, so the notice runs to 10 December 2026 at the earliest. Do you agree in writing to him leaving earlier, on 10 November 2026?

Agree in writing to an earlier end date of 10 November 2026

answers.answer: The landlord agrees in writing to a shorter notice period, for example 10 Nov, as a surrender agreed in writing. Otherwise the tenant stays liable for rent to 10 Dec. If a replacement tenant is found, the landlord may be more willing to agree.

I need to work out the notice timeline under the RRA — since only one month's notice was given but two months is required, the earliest valid end date would be 10 Dec 2026. I'm considering ways to shorten this, like landlord agreement to a shorter notice, a surrender agreement, or finding a replacement tenant, plus how the deposit gets returned through mydeposits once deductions are agreed.

I won't release keys or an address yet, just confirm handover arrangements closer to the end date. My plan is to reply to the tenant, email the landlord to request approval for an earlier end date, and schedule a follow-up — this is routine notice handling, not a maintenance issue, so no ticket needed.

arguments.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for letting us know, and congratulations on the new job.

Since 1 May 2026 the notice a tenant needs to give is two months in writing, not one. Your email of 10 October therefore ends the tenancy on 10 December 2026 at the earliest, not 10 November. Rent stays due until the tenancy ends.

A earlier date is only possible if your landlord agrees in writing. We are asking him now whether he will accept 10 November, and we can't promise the answer. Please don't treat 10 November as agreed until we confirm it in writing. We'll update you by Wednesday 14 October.

Deposit: it is held in the mydeposits scheme. It is dealt with after the tenancy ends and the property has been checked, and any deductions would be shown to you first. We can't give a return date yet.

Keys: please keep them until we confirm the handover arrangements nearer your move-out date. We'll send those details then.

Kind regards
Mare & Co Lettings

Agree in writing to an earlier end date of 10 November 2026
